title: What a resize now carries
music: playful curious explainer music, light pizzicato strings, soft marimba and warm synth pad, gentle groove, 100 bpm

scenes.heading: The resize request, at the till

lines.say: With the flag on, a resize no longer uses the BFF save.
It carries the image id, width and height to rust-resizer.
The reply is empty, so the saga adds id and status.
Check: with the flag off, the old path stays. Crop is unchanged.
